Esc and minimize in the large Computer view.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.1.2.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.1.x and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## What's changed

- **Esc reaches the bot's computer.** In the large view a normal Esc tap now goes to the bot's desktop (once, as key down + key up), so you can close menus and dialogs there.
- **Hold Esc to minimize.** Holding Esc for about a second shrinks the view back to the side-panel preview and hands control back to the bot; nothing is sent to the desktop then. A small "Hold Esc to minimize" hint shows near the corner button when you open the view and fills up while you hold.
- **Minimize button.** The close (X) button in the top-right corner is now a minimize button (arrows pointing in), with a tooltip. It does what close did: back to the preview, control back to the bot.
- **This PC:** its large screenshot view gets the same minimize button; a plain Esc tap still minimizes it (there's nothing to send keys to).
